record.original_question: Can one obtain a complete classification of homogeneous Riemannian manifolds with homogeneous geodesics (g.o. spaces, meaning homogeneous spaces in which every geodesic is an orbit of a one-parameter subgroup of the acting group) in dimension 7 and in all higher dimensions?

evidence.quote: It seems that the target for a complete classification of homogeneous g.o. spaces in any dimension greater than seven is far for being accomplished. In dimension seven there are several examples but a complete classification is still unknown.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A connected Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ is called a homogeneous space if its isometry group acts transitively; equivalently, $M = G/H$ for a Lie group $G$ acting transitively by isometries with isotropy $H$. A geodesic $\gamma:\mathbb{R}\to M$ through a point $p\in M$ is called a homogeneous geodesic (or a geodesic orbit) if there exists a one-parameter subgroup $\{\exp(tX)\}_{t\in\mathbb{R}}\subset G$ with $X\in\mathfrak{g}$ such that $\gamma(t)=\exp(tX)\cdot p$ for all $t\in\mathbb{R}$, up to affine reparametrization. The homogeneous Riemannian manifold $(M=G/H,g)$ is called a g.o. space (geodesic orbit space) if every geodesic of $(M,g)$ is a homogeneous geodesic.

Problem: Provide a complete classification, up to isometric equivalence, of all Riemannian g.o. spaces $(M=G/H,g)$ of dimension $7$, and more generally of all Riemannian g.o. spaces in every dimension $n\geq 7$.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete classification of Riemannian g.o. spaces is known only in low dimensions (up to 6); in dimension 7 only partial results exist (e.g., classification of naturally reductive 7- and 8-dimensional spaces, isolated families of non-naturally-reductive examples, results for nilmanifolds and special bundle classes), and recent surveys indicate a complete classification in dimension 7 and above remains unaccomplished.

status_evidence.title: The Classification of 7- and 8-dimensional Naturally Reductive Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Classification carried out only for the naturally reductive subclass in dimensions 7 and 8.
status_evidence.claim: Only the strictly smaller class of naturally reductive 7- and 8-dimensional spaces has been classified, not all g.o. spaces.

status_evidence.title: New examples of Riemannian g.o. manifolds in dimension 7
status_evidence.snippet: New examples of g.o. manifolds in dimension 7 are constructed.
status_evidence.claim: New 7-dimensional g.o. examples continue to be discovered, indicating no complete classification yet.

status_evidence.title: Manifolds With Homogeneous Geodesics (survey chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: Partial classifications of geodesic orbit metrics exist for special types or for small dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: A general classification beyond low dimensions or special subclasses is not available.
